naming: The loader reads the document with YamlDotNet's CamelCaseNamingConvention and refuses any key it does not know.

keys.description: Always dictionary: one lookup table kept in the repository, held in the partition's cache by a cache flow (types: [{ dictionary: <name> }]).
The dictionary's name: letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter. The file is dictionaries/<name>.yaml, and a cache flow names the dictionary by it.
The name each entry's key is kept under in the cache, which a replace matches on by default and a findBy line compares. Defaults to key.
The names of the values each entry gives. Left out, the dictionary is one of pairs: each key gives one value, kept as value.
A value's name: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _.

The table: every key once, as text exactly as written; keys that are the same once trimmed are refused. In a dictionary of pairs each key gives one text, ~ being no value; with fields, each key gives a mapping of those fields. At most 100,000 entries.
One entry: its value (a dictionary of pairs, ~ for no value), or its values by field name.
One value of the entry, under a name its fields list; ~ or left out for no value.
